def choose_move(observation):
    w, h = observation['grid_width'], observation['grid_height']
    x, y = observation['self_position']
    ox, oy = observation['opponent_position']
    resources = observation['resources']
    obstacles = set(observation.get('obstacles', []))
    rem_resources = observation['remaining_resource_count']
    score_self, score_opp = observation['scores']
    self_path = observation.get('self_path', [])
    opponent_path = observation.get('opponent_path', [])

    def safe(nx, ny):
        return 0 <= nx < w and 0 <= ny < h and (nx, ny) not in obstacles

    # Prioritize moving towards the closest resource if any
    if resources:
        target = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r[0]-x)+abs(r[1]-y))
        dx, dy = target[0]-x, target[1]-y
        move_x = 0 if dx == 0 else (1 if dx > 0 else -1)
        move_y = 0 if dy == 0 else (1 if dy > 0 else -1)
        if safe(x+move_x, y+move_y):
            return [move_x, move_y]

    # If no resources or blocked, move closer to opponent to contest
    dx, dy = ox - x, oy - y
    move_x = 0 if dx == 0 else (1 if dx > 0 else -1)
    move_y = 0 if dy == 0 else (1 if dy > 0 else -1)
    if safe(x+move_x, y+move_y):
        return [move_x, move_y]

    # Else try to move in any safe direction avoiding obstacles
    for mx, my in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
        nx, ny = x + mx, y + my
        if safe(nx, ny):
            return [mx, my]

    # If no safe move, stay in place
    return [0,0]
